name: What is the process for a kitchen remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a kitchen remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our kitchen remodel process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we move to design development, where layouts, materials, and finishes are selected. Once designs are approved and permits secured, demolition begins. This is followed by rough-ins for electrical and plumbing, insulation, drywall, cabinet installation, countertop installation, flooring, appliance setup, and final finishing touches. We maintain clear communication throughout every stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our remodel process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, demolition, rough-ins, installations of cabinets, countertops, and appliances, and final finishes.
